back_translation: Pipes and lines

xhosa_before: Ukunkcenkceshela ngamathontsi

xhosa_before: Imisele

english: This site’s own wind data reads {deg}° off the regional pattern — a bimodal wind rose average can land between its two real lobes, not on either one; trust the regional sectors over this site’s single mean.
xhosa_before: Idatha yomoya yale ndawo ibonisa umahluko we-{deg}° kwindlela yengingqi — umndilili werosi yomoya enamaqela amabini ungawela phakathi kweencopho zayo ezimbini zokwenyani, hayi kwenye yazo; kholwa ngamacandelo engingqi kunomndilili omnye wale ndawo.
back_translation: This place's wind data shows a difference of {deg} degrees from the regional pattern; the average of a two-group wind rose may fall between its two real peaks, not on either one; believe the regional sectors rather than this place's single average.

english: Slope direction is estimated from a site-local SRTM sample across about {m} m — indicative, not surveyed.
xhosa_before: Icala lethambeka lilinganiselwa ngomzekelo we-SRTM wale ndawo ojikeleza malunga ne-{m} m — isalathiso kuphela, alikalelwanga ngabalinganisi.
back_translation: The side of the slope is estimated from a sample of SRTM of this place that goes around about {m} m; an indicator only, not measured by surveyors.
note: "across about {m} m" read as "ojikeleza" (goes around); the {m} figure and "indicative, not surveyed" survive.

english: Site reads ~flat at this {m} m sampling scale — confirm fall on site.
xhosa_before: Indawo ibonakala ~ityaba kwesi sikali sokuthatha umzekelo se-{m} m — qinisekisa ukuhla kwayo kwindawo.
back_translation: The place looks about flat at this sampling scale of {m} m; confirm its fall (descent) on site.

english: Wind confirmed on site: {from}
xhosa_before: Umoya uqinisekisiwe kwindawo: {from}
back_translation: Wind is confirmed at the place: {from}

english: Wind confirmed on site: {from} (recorded {date})
xhosa_before: Umoya uqinisekisiwe kwindawo: {from} (kurekhodwe {date})
back_translation: Wind is confirmed at the place: {from} (recorded {date})

english: Place within 3 m of a roof downpipe on a compacted, level base.
xhosa_before: Beka ngaphakathi kwe-3 m kwipayipi yophahla yokuhlisa amanzi, kwisiseko esicinezelweyo nesilinganayo.
back_translation: Put it within 3 m of a roof downpipe, on a compacted, level base.

english: Needs a solid concrete ring base — full tank weighs ~2.5 t.
xhosa_before: Idinga isiseko sekhonkrithi esiqinileyo esingqukuva — itanki izeleyo inzima nge-~2.5 t.
back_translation: Needs a strong round concrete base; a full tank is heavy at about 2.5 t.
note: ~2.5 t full-tank weight kept.

english: 1.85 m diameter — check eave clearance and allow space to walk around for maintenance.
xhosa_before: Idayamitha ye-1.85 m — jonga ukuba imiphetho yophahla ayiyithinteli, uze ushiye indawo yokujikeleza ukuze uyigcine kakuhle.
back_translation: Diameter 1.85 m; check the roof edges don't obstruct it, and leave space to move around it so you can keep it well.

english: 2.2 m diameter, 3.15 m tall — site on a reinforced slab near the largest roof catchment.
xhosa_before: Idayamitha ye-2.2 m, ubude be-3.15 m — yibeke kwisileyibhu esomeleziweyo kufuphi nophahla olubamba amanzi amaninzi kakhulu.
back_translation: Diameter 2.2 m, length 3.15 m; put it on a reinforced slab near the roof that catches the most water.

english: Good starter option under a small downpipe before investing in a JoJo.
xhosa_before: Ukhetho olulungileyo lokuqala phantsi kwepayipi encinci yokuhlisa amanzi phambi kokuba uthenge itanki ye-JoJo.
back_translation: A good first choice under a small downpipe before you buy a JoJo tank.

english: Line with clay or pond liner; site in a natural low point to catch runoff.
xhosa_before: Yigqume ngodongwe okanye ngelayina yechibi; yibeke kwindawo esezantsi ngokwendalo ukuze ibambe amanzi abalekayo.
back_translation: Cover with clay or a pond liner; put it in a naturally low place to hold runoff water.

english: Site on-contour below a catchment area; check DWS licensing thresholds for dam size.
xhosa_before: Yibeke ilandela umgca wokuphakama ngezantsi kwendawo ebamba amanzi; jonga imida yelayisensi ye-DWS ngobukhulu beedama.
back_translation: Put it following the contour line below the catchment area; check DWS licence limits for dam sizes.

english: Get a hydrogeological siting survey before drilling — avoid septic/kraal runoff zones.
xhosa_before: Fumana uvavanyo lwe-hydrogeology lokukhetha indawo phambi kokumba — phepha iindawo apho kubalekela khona amanzi esepthiki okanye esibayeni.
back_translation: Get a hydrogeology test for choosing the place before digging; avoid places where septic or kraal water flows to.
note: "drilling" read as "ukumba" (digging). The siting survey and the avoid-septic/kraal-runoff caveat are intact; digging a borehole is understood the same way. Locale already words "borehole" as "umngxuma wamanzi".

english: Place at bed corners for easy hose access without crossing paths.
xhosa_before: Beka kumakona ebhedi ukuze ifikeleleke lula ngepayipi yamanzi ungawelanga iindlela.
back_translation: Put at the corners of the bed so it is easily reached by the water pipe without crossing the paths.

english: Position on firm, well-drained ground away from the dam edge to reduce erosion.
xhosa_before: Yibeke emhlabeni oqinileyo, ophuma kakuhle amanzi, kude nomphetho wedama ukuze kuncitshiswe ukukhukuliseka komhlaba.
back_translation: Put on firm, well-draining ground, away from the dam edge to reduce soil erosion.

english: On the downpipe before the tank — diverts the first dirty roof runoff (leaves, dust, bird mess) so only clean water is stored.
xhosa_before: Kwipayipi yokuhlisa amanzi phambi kwetanki — iphambukisa amanzi okuqala angcolileyo ophahleni (amagqabi, uthuli, inkunkuma yeentaka) ukuze kugcinwe amanzi acocekileyo kuphela.
back_translation: On the downpipe before the tank; it diverts the first dirty water from the roof (leaves, dust, bird droppings) so only clean water is kept.

english: Site near the tanks on a firm base — regulates pressure for drip lines and filters grit before irrigation.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kufuphi neetanki kwisiseko esiqinileyo — ilawula uxinzelelo lwemigca yokunkcenkceshela ngamathontsi kwaye isefa intlabathi phambi kokunkcenkceshela.
back_translation: Put near the tanks on a firm base; it controls the pressure of the drip lines and filters sand before watering.

english: Keep it 1.2 m wide — any wider and you cannot reach the middle from both sides. Fill 30-40 cm deep over loosened subsoil.
xhosa_before: Yigcine ibubanzi be-1.2 m — ukuba ibanzi ngaphezulu awunakufikelela embindini usuka macala omabini. Yizalise ngobunzulu be-30-40 cm ngaphezu komhlaba ongaphantsi osele ukhululwe.
back_translation: Keep it 1.2 m wide; if wider you can't reach the middle from both sides. Fill it to 30-40 cm depth above the loosened subsoil.

english: Central compost basket feeds the whole bed — ideal near the kitchen door.
xhosa_before: Ibhasikithi yomgquba esembindini iyondla ibhedi yonke — ilungile ukuba kufuphi nomnyango wekhitshi.
back_translation: The central compost basket feeds the whole bed; good to be near the kitchen door.

english: Build up to 1-1.2 m high with rubble core; place right outside the kitchen door.
xhosa_before: Yakhe ide ifike kubude be-1-1.2 m inentliziyo yamatye amaqhekeka; yibeke ngaphandle nje komnyango wekhitshi.
back_translation: Build until it reaches 1-1.2 m in height with a heart of broken stones; put just outside the kitchen door.

english: Dig a 2 m pit for the compost core; feeds off greywater and kitchen waste.
xhosa_before: Mba umngxuma we-2 m wentliziyo yomgquba; iyondliwa yi-greywater nenkunkuma yasekhitshini.
back_translation: Dig a 2 m hole of compost heart; it is fed by greywater and kitchen waste.
note: 2 m kept; dimension (width or depth) is not stated in the English either.

english: Plant the tree on a low raised mound, then ring it with a mulch-filled moat — roof or greywater runoff soaks in through the ring, at the feeder roots, while the trunk and crown stay high and dry. Never plant a fruit tree standing in the dip.
xhosa_before: Tyala umthi kwinduli ephantsi ephakanyisiweyo, uze uyijikelezise ngomjelo ogcwele ingca yokugquma — amanzi abalekayo ophahleni okanye e-greywater angena emhlabeni ngalo mjikelezo, kwiingcambu ezondlayo, ngoxa isiqu nesithsaba zihlala ziphezulu zome. Musa ukutyala umthi weziqhamo emngxunyeni.
back_translation: Plant a tree on a low raised hill and surround it with a channel full of mulch; roof runoff or greywater enters the ground through this circle to the feeding roots while stem and crown stay high and dry. Do not plant a fruit tree in the hole.
note: Never plant a fruit tree standing in the dip: kept (Musa).

english: Feed from kitchen/laundry outlet into a mulch-filled banana or fruit tree basin.
xhosa_before: Ondla ukusuka kwindawo ephumayo yekhitshi/yokuwasha ukuya kwibheseni yebhanana okanye yomthi weziqhamo egcwele ingca yokugquma.
back_translation: Feed from the kitchen/washing outlet to a banana basin or fruit-tree basin full of mulch.

english: Where greywater LEAVES the house — the bath, shower, basin or laundry drain you are tapping. Put it on that wall, then run the line to a banana circle or tree basin. Never tap the toilet (that is blackwater), and use plant-safe soap.
xhosa_before: Apho i-greywater IPHUMA khona endlini — indawo ephuma kuyo yebhafu, yeshawa, yebheseni okanye yokuwasha oyithabathayo. Yibeke kuloo donga, uze uhambise umbhobho uye kwisangqa sebhanana okanye kwibheseni yomthi. Musa ukuthabatha kwindlu yangasese (leyo yi-blackwater), uze usebenzise isepha ekhuselekileyo kwizityalo.
back_translation: Where greywater COMES OUT of the house; the outlet of a bath, shower, basin or washing that you choose. Place it on that wall and move the pipe to a banana circle or tree basin. Don't take from the toilet (that is blackwater), and use soap that is safe for plants.
note: Never tap the toilet / blackwater / plant-safe soap: all kept.

english: Valve plus leaf filter on the outlet: sends greywater to the garden in the dry season, and back to the sewer or soakaway when you need it to.
xhosa_before: Ivalvu kunye nesihluzi samagqabi kwindawo ephumayo: ithumela i-greywater egadini ngexesha elomileyo, ize iyibuyisele kumjelo wenkunkuma okanye kumngxuma wokufunxa xa uyidinga.
back_translation: A valve and leaf filter at the outlet: sends greywater to the garden in dry time, and returns it to the waste channel or the soakaway when you need.

english: A shallow flat-bottomed dish (30-50 cm deep) that ponds runoff so it soaks away. Site where water already collects, but keep 5 m clear of foundations.
xhosa_before: Isitya esingenanzulu, esiphantsi sithe tyaba (30-50 cm ubunzulu) esibamba amanzi abalekayo ukuze afunxeke emhlabeni. Sibeke apho amanzi esele ehlanganisana khona, kodwa gcina i-5 m phakathi kwaso neziseko zezakhiwo.
back_translation: A shallow, low dish (30-50 cm depth) that holds runoff so it soaks into the ground. Put it where water already gathers, but keep 5 m between it and building foundations.
note: "flat-bottomed" read as "low, slightly flat"; 30-50 cm depth and the 5 m clearance from foundations are intact.

english: Semi-circular earth bund (demi-lune) with the arms on contour and the opening uphill — Sahel technique to water one tree in dry country.
xhosa_before: Indonga yomhlaba enesiqingatha senyanga (demi-lune) ineengalo zayo zilandela umgca wokuphakama nokuvuleka kujonge ngaphezulu kwethambeka — indlela yaseSahel yokunkcenkcesha umthi omnye kumhlaba owomileyo.
back_translation: An earth wall with half-moon shape with its arms following the contour and opening facing uphill; Sahel way of watering one tree in dry ground.

english: A raised earth ridge on contour. Either the mound on the downhill side of a swale trench, or a standalone contour bank that catches runoff and leads it to a safe outlet. Plant it as soon as it is built so it binds.
xhosa_before: Induli yomhlaba ephakanyisiweyo elandela umgca wokuphakama. Mhlawumbi yinduli esezantsi kwethambeka kumsele obhuliweyo, okanye yibhanki yomgca wokuphakama emile yodwa ebamba amanzi abalekayo iwakhokelele kwindawo ephuma ngokukhuselekileyo. Yityale kwangoko emva kokuba yakhiwe ukuze ibambe umhlaba.
back_translation: A raised earth mound following the contour. Perhaps a mound below the slope of a dug swale, or a standing contour bank that holds runoff and leads it to a safe outlet. Plant it immediately after it is built to hold the soil.

english: Cut-and-fill a level shelf across steep ground (steeper than ~1:5). Retain the face with rock, gabion or vetiver or it will slump.
xhosa_before: Mba uze uzalise wenze iqonga elilinganayo ngaphesheya kwethambeka elibukhali (elibukhali ngaphezu kwe-~1:5). Bamba ubuso ngamatye, ngegabiyoni okanye ngevetiver, kungenjalo buya kuwa.
back_translation: Dig and fill to make a level platform across a sharp slope (sharper than about 1:5). Hold the face with stones, gabion or vetiver, otherwise it will fall.

english: A living bank of vetiver you cut again and again for mulch and compost. Use the sterile, non-seeding cultivar — not a seeding local relative — so it stays a mulch bank and not a spreading grass. Slash it a few times a season, drop the leaf straight onto beds and tree basins. Its deep roots also hold the soil where it stands.
xhosa_before: Ibhanki ephilayo yevetiver oyinqumla amaxesha amaninzi ukuze ufumane ingca yokugquma nomgquba. Sebenzisa uhlobo olungenakuzala, olungenambewu — hayi isalamane sasekuhlaleni esinembewu — ukuze ihlale iyibhanki yengca yokugquma kungabi yingca esasazekayo. Yinqumle amaxesha ambalwa ngesizini, uwise amagqabi ngqo ebhedini nasebhesenini yemithi. Iingcambu zayo ezinzulu zibamba nomhlaba apho imi khona.
back_translation: A living vetiver bank that you cut many times to get mulch and compost. Use a kind that cannot breed, seedless, not a local seeded relative, so that it stays a bank of mulch and does not become a spreading weed. Cut it a few times in a season, drop the leaves straight on the bed and tree basin. Its deep roots also hold the soil where it stands.
note: Sterile, non-seeding cultivar (not a seeding local relative) kept.

english: Keep tools near the main work zone but out of prevailing rain direction.
xhosa_before: Gcina izixhobo kufuphi nendawo ephambili yomsebenzi kodwa zingekho ngakwicala imvula evela kulo rhoqo.
back_translation: Keep tools near the main work area but not on the side the rain usually comes from.

english: Orient the ridge north-south for even light; anchor well against wind.
xhosa_before: Beka incopho ilandela umgca osuka emantla ukuya emzantsi ukuze ukukhanya kulingane; yibophe kakuhle emhlabeni ukuze ime nomoya.
back_translation: Put the peak following a line from north to south so the light is balanced; tie it well to the ground so it stands in the wind.
note: "ridge" is "incopho" (peak); north-south direction and anchoring against wind survive, only the noun is loose. For a fluent reviewer.

english: Use 40-50% shade netting for SA summer sun; site near the nursery table.
xhosa_before: Sebenzisa umnatha wesithunzi we-40-50% ngenxa yelanga lasehlotyeni laseMzantsi Afrika; yibeke kufuphi netafile yeempandla.
back_translation: Use a 40-50% shade net because of South African summer sun; put it near the herb table.
note: "nursery table" is "itafile yeempandla" (read blind as herb table); same draft as g52/g43, flagged there. 40-50% kept.

english: Close enough for daily egg collection, downwind of the house.
xhosa_before: Kufuphi ngokwaneleyo ukuze uqokelele amaqanda yonke imihla, ngakwicala lapho umoya uya khona esuka endlini.
back_translation: Close enough to collect eggs every day, on the side the wind goes to from the house.
note: Downwind wording from the 2 Nov (b) repair, intact.

english: Movable — rotate across beds or orchard rows for pest control and manure.
xhosa_before: Iyahanjiswa — yijikeleze ngaphesheya kwemibhede okanye imigca yemithi yeziqhamo ukulawula izinambuzane nokufumana ubulongwe.
back_translation: It is moved; rotate it across the beds or fruit-tree rows to control pests and get manure.
note: ubulongwe read as manure; consistent with existing shards.

english: Site downhill and downwind of the house; capture runoff for a manure compost pit.
xhosa_before: Sibeke ezantsi kwethambeka kwaye ngakwicala lapho umoya uya khona esuka endlini; bamba amanzi abalekayo ukuze wenze umngxuma womgquba webulongwe.
back_translation: Put it down the slope and on the side the wind goes to from the house; catch runoff to make a hole of compost of manure.
note: Downhill + downwind (earlier-review wording) intact.

english: Three ~1x1m bins in a row for turning stages; keep near veg beds to shorten wheelbarrow runs.
xhosa_before: Iingqayi ezintathu ze-~1x1m ngokulandelelana ukuze ujike umgquba ngamanqanaba; ziseke kufuphi nemibhede yemifuno ukuze uncinane ukutyhala ibharoweli.
back_translation: Three bins of about 1x1 m in a row to turn the compost in stages; set them near the vegetable beds to reduce pushing a wheelbarrow.

english: Keep in shade near the kitchen for easy scrap disposal.
xhosa_before: Gcina ithunzini kufuphi nekhitshi ukuze kube lula ukulahla intsalela yokutya.
back_translation: Keep in the shade near the kitchen so food scraps are easy to throw away.

english: Site close to a tap for daily seedling watering.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kufuphi nethepi ukuze unkcenkceshele izithole rhoqo ngemihla.
back_translation: Put near a tap to water seedlings often every day.

english: Keep it clear of greywater, thorny species and vehicle access — and site it where it can be seen from the kitchen or classroom.
xhosa_before: Yigcine kude ne-greywater, nezityalo ezinameva nendlela yeemoto — uze uyibeke apho ibonakala khona ukusuka ekhitshini okanye eklasini.
back_translation: Keep it away from greywater, thorny plants and the car road, and put it where it is visible from the kitchen or classroom.

english: Place near the gate/road frontage for customer access.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kufuphi nesango/necala lendlela ukuze abathengi bayifikelele.
back_translation: Put near the gate/side of the road so customers can reach it.

english: Keep within daily-visit distance of the kitchen door; full sun, north-facing rows.
xhosa_before: Yigcine kumgama ongayindwendwela yonke imihla usuka emnyango wekhitshi; ilanga elipheleleyo, imigca ejonge emantla.
back_translation: Keep within a distance you can visit every day from the kitchen door; full sun, rows facing north.

english: Full sun, frost-protected spot; keep 4 m from structures for mature canopy.
xhosa_before: Ilanga elipheleleyo, indawo ekhuselekileyo kumkhenkce; gcina i-4 m ukusuka kwizakhiwo ukuze isithsaba esikhulileyo sibe nendawo.
back_translation: Full sun, place safe from frost; keep 4 m from buildings so the mature crown has room.

english: The most frost-hardy of the citrus — still wants full sun and 4 m clearance at maturity.
xhosa_before: Yeyona inyamezela umkhenkce kakhulu kwiisitrasi — isafuna ilanga elipheleleyo kunye ne-4 m yendawo xa ikhulile.
back_translation: It is the most frost-tolerant of the citrus; still wants full sun and 4 m of space when grown.

english: Needs more heat than other citrus and a longer frost-free spell; full sun, 5 m clearance at maturity.
xhosa_before: Ifuna ubushushu obungakumbi kunezinye iisitrasi kunye nexesha elide elingenamkhenkce; ilanga elipheleleyo, i-5 m yendawo xa ikhulile.
back_translation: Needs more warmth than other citrus and a long frost-free time; full sun, 5 m of space when grown.

english: Mature canopy can reach 10 m+ — give it real room, frost-free warm zone.
xhosa_before: Isithsaba esikhulileyo sinokufikelela kwi-10 m+ — yinike indawo eyaneleyo, indawo efudumeleyo engenamkhenkce.
back_translation: The mature crown can reach 10 m+; give it enough room, a warm place without frost.

english: Needs good drainage, wind shelter, and 8 m clearance at maturity.
xhosa_before: Ifuna amanzi aphuma kakuhle, isikhuselo somoya, kunye ne-8 m yendawo xa ikhulile.
back_translation: Needs well-draining water, wind protection and 8 m of space when grown.

english: Slow-growing but wide canopy eventually — plant well back from paths and beds.
xhosa_before: Ikhula ngokucotha kodwa ekugqibeleni inesithsaba esibanzi — yityale kude kakhulu neendlela nemibhede.
back_translation: Grows slowly but in the end has a wide crown; plant very far from paths and beds.

english: Hidden from new designs because guava can be invasive in warm coastal areas. Kept so old saved designs still render.
xhosa_before: Ifihliwe kwiiyilo ezintsha kuba iguava inokusasazeka ngokungalawulekiyo kwiindawo ezifudumeleyo zonxweme. Igcinwe ukuze iiyilo ezindala ezigciniweyo zisabonakala.
back_translation: Hidden from new designs because guava can spread uncontrollably in warm coastal areas. Kept so old saved designs still show.
note: Invasive guava caveat kept.

english: Wide dense canopy at maturity — needs subtropical frost-free conditions.
xhosa_before: Isithsaba esibanzi esixineneyo xa sikhulile — sifuna imeko ye-subtropical engenamkhenkce.
back_translation: A wide dense crown when mature; needs a subtropical, frost-free condition.

english: Fast-growing and short-lived — good gap-filler near the kitchen garden.
xhosa_before: Ikhula ngokukhawuleza kodwa ayihlali ixesha elide — ilungele ukuzalisa izikhewu kufuphi negadi yekhitshi.
back_translation: Grows quickly but does not live long; good for filling gaps near the kitchen garden.

english: Prune hard annually for leaf harvest to control size near beds.
xhosa_before: Yinqumle kakhulu minyaka le ukuze uvune amagqabi uze ulawule ubungakanani bayo kufuphi nemibhede.
back_translation: Cut it back hard every year to harvest leaves and to control its size near beds.

english: Indigenous fruiting coastal shrub/tree; useful as an edible hedge or small orchard edge.
xhosa_before: Isihlahlana/umthi wesiqhamo wemveli wonxweme; wenza uthango olunokutyiwa okanye umphetho wegadi encinci yeziqhamo.
back_translation: A native coastal shrub/fruit tree; makes an edible hedge or the edge of a small fruit garden.

english: This is the coastal/subtropical Wild Plum (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya — not the drier-region Wild Plum (Pappea capensis), which is a smaller tree not yet in this catalog. Give it room away from beds and buildings.
xhosa_before: Esi yi-Wild Plum yonxweme/ye-subtropical (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya — hayi i-Wild Plum yengingqi eyomileyo (Pappea capensis), engumthi omncinci ongekho kolu luhlu okwangoku. Yinike indawo kude nemibhede nezakhiwo.
back_translation: This is the coastal/subtropical Wild Plum (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya, not the dry-region Wild Plum (Pappea capensis), which is a small tree not on this list yet. Give it room away from beds and buildings.

english: Indigenous fruiting shade tree for moister edges and wildlife-friendly food forest zones.
xhosa_before: Umthi wesithunzi wemveli onesiqhamo wemiphetho enamanzi ngakumbi kunye neendawo zehlathi lokutya ezinobubele kwizilwanyana zasendle.
back_translation: Native shade tree with fruit for wetter edges and food-forest places that are kind to wildlife.

english: Big savanna shade tree — give it 12 m and keep it well back from buildings. Only female trees fruit, so plant several seedlings if you want a crop.
xhosa_before: Umthi omkhulu wesithunzi wesavana — wunike i-12 m uze uwugcine kude kakhulu nezakhiwo. Imithi yesifazane kuphela ezalayo, ngoko tyala izithole ezininzi ukuba ufuna isivuno.
back_translation: Big savanna shade tree; give it 12 m and keep it very far from buildings. Only female trees bear, so plant many seedlings if you want a harvest.
note: Only female trees fruit: kept.

english: Thorny and very hardy — takes frost, drought and wind. Grown as a stock-proof edible hedge as often as a single tree. Only female plants fruit.
xhosa_before: Inameva kwaye iyomelela kakhulu — inyamezela umkhenkce, imbalela nomoya. Ityalwa njengothango olutyiwayo olukhusela imfuyo rhoqo njengomthi omnye. Izityalo zesifazane kuphela ezizalayo.
back_translation: Thorny and very tough; tolerates frost, drought and wind. Planted as an edible hedge that protects livestock always, as a single tree. Only female plants bear.
xhosa_after: Ityalwa njengothango olutyiwayo olungangenwa yimfuyo, okanye njengomthi omnye.
note: "stock-proof" read as "protects livestock" (shelters animals, not keeps them out) and "as often as a single tree" read as "always ... as a single tree" (rhoqo). Now: a hedge that livestock cannot enter, or a single tree. Female-only fruiting caveat intact.

english: Place the canopy, then tap it and rename it to the exact species.
xhosa_before: Beka isithsaba, uze ucofe kuso uze uphinde ulubize igama ngohlobo oluchanekileyo.
back_translation: Place the crown, then click on it and call its name again in the correct way.

english: Heavy feeder — site near greywater outflow or compost area.
xhosa_before: Idla kakhulu — yibeke kufuphi nendawo ephuma kuyo i-greywater okanye indawo yomgquba.
back_translation: Eats a lot; put near the greywater outlet or the compost place.

english: Use for windbreaks and wildlife corridors on the property edge.
xhosa_before: Sebenzisa ukwenza izikhuseli zomoya neendlela zezilwanyana zasendle emphethweni womhlaba wakho.
back_translation: Use to make windbreaks and wildlife paths at the edge of your land.

english: Needs winter cold (chill) to fruit — good on the Highveld; pick a low-chill variety in milder spots.
xhosa_before: Ifuna ubusika obubandayo (chill) ukuze izale — ilunge kwi-Highveld; khetha uhlobo olufuna ubanda obuncinci kwiindawo ezingabandanga kangako.
back_translation: Needs a cold winter (chill) to bear; good in the Highveld; choose a type needing little cold in places that are not so cold.

english: Cold-hardy and long-lived; needs a second variety nearby for good pollination.
xhosa_before: Inyamezela ukubanda kwaye ihlala ixesha elide; ifuna olunye uhlobo kufuphi ukuze kuthwalwe umungu wentyatyambo kakuhle.
back_translation: Tolerates cold and lives long; needs another kind nearby so pollen is carried well.

english: Frost-hardy stone fruit; blossoms early so avoid the coldest frost pockets.
xhosa_before: Isiqhamo esinembewu enzima esinyamezela umkhenkce; sityatyamba kwangoko ngoko phepha iindawo zomkhenkce ezibanda kakhulu.
back_translation: Fruit with a hard seed that tolerates frost; it blossoms early so avoid the very cold frost places.
note: "stone fruit" is "isiqhamo esinembewu enzima" (fruit with hard seed); frost-pocket caveat intact.

english: Prune to an open vase each winter; needs some chill but tolerates mild-frost hinterland too.
xhosa_before: Yinqumle ibe ngathi yivazi evulekileyo ebusika ngabunye; ifuna ubanda obuthile kodwa inyamezela nengingqi engaphakathi enomkhenkce obuthathaka.
back_translation: Prune it like an open vase in winter, one by one; needs some cold but also tolerates the inland region with light frost.
note: "each winter" read as "in winter, one by one" (ngabunye). No site or safety consequence.

english: Very adaptable — handles frost, heat and dry spells. Roots are vigorous, keep clear of walls/pipes.
xhosa_before: Iyazivumelanisa kakhulu — inyamezela umkhenkce, ubushushu namaxesha omileyo. Iingcambu zayo zomelele, yigcine kude neendonga/nemibhobho.
back_translation: Very adaptable; tolerates frost, heat and dry times. Its roots are strong, keep it away from walls/pipes.

english: Loves hot dry summers; drought-hardy once established. Good for Karoo and Highveld gardens.
xhosa_before: Iyayithanda ihlobo elishushu elomileyo; inyamezela imbalela xa sele iqhelene. Ilungele iigadi zeKaroo neHighveld.
back_translation: Likes hot dry summer; tolerates drought once used to it. Good for Karoo and Highveld gardens.

english: Mediterranean and Karoo star — drought- and frost-tolerant; needs a dry, sunny, well-drained spot.
xhosa_before: Inkwenkwezi yeMeditera neKaroo — inyamezela imbalela nomkhenkce; ifuna indawo eyomileyo, enelanga, ephuma kakuhle amanzi.
back_translation: The star of the Mediterranean and Karoo; tolerates drought and frost; needs a dry, sunny, well-draining place.

english: Anything the catalog does not cover yet — place it, then tap it to give it a name.
xhosa_before: Nantoni na engekho kuluhlu okwangoku — yibeke, uze ucofe kuyo uyinike igama.
back_translation: Anything not on the list yet; put it, click on it and give it a name.

english: Mix indigenous flowering species along orchard edges to boost fruit set.
xhosa_before: Xuba izityalo zemveli ezidubulayo ecaleni kwemiphetho yegadi yeziqhamo ukunyusa ukuthwala kweziqhamo.
back_translation: Mix native flowering plants along the edges of the orchard to increase fruit bearing.

english: Plant cuttings 20-30 cm apart as a firebreak/browse hedge — extremely drought-hardy.
xhosa_before: Tyala iinqumlo ngomgama we-20-30 cm njengesithintelo somlilo/uthango oludliwa zizilwanyana — luyayinyamezela kakhulu imbalela.
back_translation: Plant cuttings 20-30 cm apart as a fire barrier / hedge eaten by animals; very drought tolerant.

english: Plant on-contour with slips 10-15 cm apart to stop erosion on slopes. Use the sterile, non-seeding cultivar so the line holds ground rather than spreading as a seeding grass.
xhosa_before: Tyala ulandela umgca wokuphakama ngeziqwengana ezingomgama we-10-15 cm ukuthintela ukukhukuliseka komhlaba emathambekeni. Sebenzisa uhlobo olungenakuzala, olungenambewu ukuze umgca ubambe umhlaba endaweni yokusasazeka njengengca ezala imbewu.
back_translation: Plant following the contour with slips 10-15 cm apart to stop soil erosion on slopes. Use a kind that cannot breed, seedless, so the line holds the soil instead of spreading like a seed-producing grass.
note: Sterile, non-seeding cultivar kept.

english: Face entrance east, away from foot traffic; keep 5-10 m clear approach path.
xhosa_before: Yijongise ukungena kwayo empuma, kude nendlela abantu abahamba kuyo; gcina indlela ecacileyo yokusondela ye-5-10 m.
back_translation: Make its entrance face east, away from the way people walk; keep a clear approach of 5-10 m.

english: Sturdy fencing essential — goats browse anything reachable, keep away from young trees.
xhosa_before: Uthango oluqinileyo luyimfuneko — iibhokhwe zidla nantoni na ezifikelela kuyo, zigcine kude nemithi emincinci.
back_translation: A strong fence is a must; goats eat anything they reach, keep away from young trees.

english: Downhill of water sources, with shade and a wallow; strong odour control needed near house.
xhosa_before: Ezantsi kwethambeka kwemithombo yamanzi, inesithunzi nendawo yokuzigaqa ebudakeni; kufuneka ulawule kakhulu ivumba ukuba kufuphi nendlu.
back_translation: Down the slope from water sources, with shade and a place to wallow in mud; you must control the smell a lot if close to the house.

english: Pair with the orchard for natural snail and pest control.
xhosa_before: Yidibanise negadi yeziqhamo ukulawula ngokwendalo ii-snail nezinye izinambuzane ezonakalisayo.
back_translation: Combine with the orchard to control snails and other harmful pests naturally.
note: "ii-snail" is a plain English loanword; read blind as "snails" without trouble. No existing shard words snail (grep), so no precedent to match. Kept; fluent reviewer to supply a native word if one is in common use.

english: Raise off ground; manure drops straight to a compost or worm bin below.
xhosa_before: Phakamisa emhlabeni; ubulongwe wehla ngqo uye kumgquba okanye kwingqayi yeentshulube engezantsi.
back_translation: Lift off the ground; manure goes straight down into the compost or the worm bin below.
note: "ubulongwe wehla" has a concord slip (ubulongwe would take "buhla"); meaning clear. "ubulongwe" read as manure/dung, consistent with soilAmendmentKraalManure and rows 52/53/95. Worm bin = "ingqayi yeentshulube", consistent with "Ifama yeentshulube".

english: Place at the kraal fence line for easy refilling without entering the pen.
xhosa_before: Sibeke emgceni wothango lwesibaya ukuze sizaliswe lula ungangeni ekholweni.
back_translation: Put in the kraal fence line so it is easily filled without entering the kraal.

english: Site near the kraal/pig pen for manure feedstock; pipe gas to the kitchen.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kufuphi nesibaya/nekhola yehagu ukuze ufumane ubulongwe bokuyondla; hambisa igesi ngombhobho uye ekhitshini.
back_translation: Put near the kraal/pig pen to get manure to feed it; move the gas by pipe to the kitchen.

english: Anchor over seating or nursery areas; orient to block harsh afternoon sun.
xhosa_before: Yibophe ngaphezu kweendawo zokuhlala okanye iindawo zeempandla; yijongise ukuze ivale ilanga elishushu kakhulu emva kwemini.
back_translation: Tie it over seating places or herb places; aim it to block the very hot afternoon sun.
note: "nursery areas" read as "herb places" (iempandla), same wording issue as row 50; "orient to block afternoon sun" intact.

english: Align with the main path for straightforward vehicle and foot access.
xhosa_before: Yilungelelanise nendlela ephambili ukuze iimoto nabahamba ngeenyawo bangene ngokulula.
back_translation: Line it up with the main road so vehicles and pedestrians enter easily.

english: Site under shade with a view over the main growing area.
xhosa_before: Ibeke ethunzini ibe nembono yendawo ephambili yokutyala.
back_translation: Put it in the shade with a view of the main planting place.

english: Place at path junctions for orientation or market-day signage.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kwimihlanganiso yeendlela ukukhokela abantu okanye njengophawu losuku lwemarike.
back_translation: Put at road junctions to guide people or as a sign for market day.

english: Angle north-facing and unshaded for peak SA solar yield.
xhosa_before: Yithambekise ijonge emantla kwaye ingenasithunzi ukuze ifumane amandla elanga amaninzi kakhulu eMzantsi Afrika.
back_translation: Tilt it to face north and without shade to get the most solar energy in South Africa.

english: Site in full sun close to the house, clear of tree drip lines.
xhosa_before: Yibeke kwilanga elipheleleyo kufuphi nendlu, kude nendawo apho amathontsi emithi awela khona.
back_translation: Put in full sun near the house, away from where tree drips fall.
